//: BrowserRouter means all routing is client-side, so any path other than / must still serve index.html. Without this, a hard refresh or a shared link to /events/<slug> returns 404 — and critically so does /payment/success, where Paystack redirects buyers after a successful charge. Vercel matches real files first, so /assets/* is served from disk and never reaches this rewrite.
//cache: Vite fingerprints asset filenames (index-DxF42tUJ.js), so those are safe to cache forever. index.html itself must not be, or buyers keep loading a stale bundle after a deploy.
